talk.text: Wait. How deep is that hole?
Thirteen storeys deep! It's Chand Baori, a stepwell in Abhaneri, India, built around the year eight hundred.

label.name: The steps
label.meta: Stairs all the way down to the water

talk.text: So people could reach the water at any level, wherever it had dropped to.
And what's that shady walkway for?
Shade and deep stone. The whole place works as a climate machine.
Nobody knows! The builders were never recorded.

scenes.line: 248 buildings with water on the site

outro: No way. Where do I find more like this?
